objective_contribution: Reduce invalid GLM small-window outcomes by testing deterministic schema-bound terminal submission, so later state comparisons measure useful context rather than avoidable serialization failure. Completion and native outcome quality remain separate from total model-token cost.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Can schema-bound no-effect terminal submission improve valid completion without changing source delivery, effects, context, or model-token caps?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Tokenizer preflight, exact source closure, continuity freeze review, and verified D08 freeze criterion.

measurement_mapping.instrument: Valid terminal submission, exact successful-response binding, zero executor invocation, whole-envelope diagnostics and native-score availability.
measurement_mapping.native: Final source metrics after valid export; neither valid serialization nor patch presence proves repair correctness.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Every model input and output token, including failed submissions and correction, under unchanged 96000 per-cell cap.
measurement_mapping.retention: Not directly tested by this terminal-shape experiment.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Other models, domains and windows remain unproven.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window first; exact 8K development diagnostic before 10K/12K and confirmation.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: All round-one through round-four attempts remain exposed development evidence. Round five reuses only the three explicit round-four terminal failures; confirmation remains untouched.

retained_counterevidence: Round four H1 complete-pair span-F1 gain was 0.000819, below 0.05, with file-F1 degradation and three missing pairs.
Two failures were invalid JSON; one was invalid source provenance after correction.
H7 eliminated context stops in the observed cohort but used 17 deferrals and has no isolated causal comparison.
Structured submission cannot manufacture relevant evidence or repair a wrong source-version choice.
successor_rule: Freeze and run a matched free-form versus structured terminal experiment only after R5-I/E/D/F pass. If H9 meets its predeclared completion and integrity criteria, retain it as common candidate instrumentation and create a new H1/state hypothesis round. Otherwise select H10 or revise toward evidence semantics from the reviewed failures. Preserve thresholds, histories and confirmation; never restore SWE-bench automatically.
